(2) Writ petition was dismissed for 
non-prosecution on 28.12.2020. Today, 
the matter is listed on restoration 
application (MCC/15498/2022). There is 
delay of 15 months and 12 days in filing 
the restoration application. 
(3) Learned Counsel for the 
applicant submits that writ petition was 
got dismissed for non-prosecution due to 
unavoidable circumstances, beyond 
control of the petitioner. 
(4) For the reasons indicated, delay 
is condoned and restoration application is 
allowed, subject to payment of cost of 
rupees ten thousand, to be deposited 
with Advocates Welfare Fund maintained 
by Uttarakhand High Court Bar 
Association within ten days. Subject to 
payment of cost, writ petition is restored 
to its original number.
